tools.name: list_npl_capabilities
tools.description: Read the public NPL catalog: eleven capability families, eight machine operation contracts, access boundaries and offline Passport links. Returns the catalog as JSON in structuredContent and text. Does not access a private Home, execute a function, or request payment. No parameters. Example tools/ca

tools.name: inspect_npl_pricing
tools.description: Read the eight public NPL Base reference tariffs and units, planned maximums, and payment-rail availability. Returns operations, variable_authorization_ceilings_usd and operational_status as JSON in structuredContent and text. Base collection is disabled; only Passport has the separately described C

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "inspect_npl_pricing" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
